panels.title: Players online
panels.description: Largest of the footer, tab list and status ping counts, so it stays known while the proxy is offline if the status ping is on

panels.title: Players online
panels.description: The sources should mostly agree. Footer and tab list are only known in game, the status ping always

panels.title: Player history

targets.expr: max by (player) (zenith_server_player_online{instance="$instance",player=~"$player"}) and on (player) topk(30, sum by (player) (count_over_time(zenith_server_player_online{instance="$instance",player=~"$player"}[$__range] @ end())))

defaults.noValue: No players. Turn on with: zenithExporter players on

panels.description: Who was online when. With All selected, the 30 players online longest in this time range; pick names in the Player filter at the top to see specific ones. A gap means offline, or the proxy not being in game: compare with Connection state

panels.title: Players seen in this time range
panels.description: Time online only counts time the proxy was in game to see them. Last seen is accurate to a minute

panels.title: Watch list

defaults.noValue: Add players with: zenithExporter watch add <player>

panels.description: Players from the watch list, which also shows them explicitly as offline

panels.title: Player latency

targets.expr: max by (player) (zenith_server_player_latency_seconds{instance="$instance",player=~"$player"}) and on (player) topk(5, sum by (player) (count_over_time(zenith_server_player_online{instance="$instance",player=~"$player"}[$__range] @ end())))

panels.description: Five players online longest, narrow down with the Player filter

defaults.noValue: No data: the exporter or Prometheus was down

panels.title: Disconnects
panels.description: Per minute or more, depending on the time range

panels.title: Damage taken
panels.description: Health points in this time range

panels.title: Attacked
panels.description: By other players, in this time range

panels.title: Y level
panels.description: x and z need: zenithExporter position on

panels.title: Speed
panels.description: Blocks per second, teleports not counted

panels.title: Server activity
panels.description: How fast the server hands out entity ids, a rough measure of how much is going on
